title: Fields and quiet controls you can find
question: In dark mode a text box on a panel is the same colour as the panel, so the note box in your screenshot only shows as its resize corner; quiet buttons, filter chips and switches fade the same way, and in light they are a faint beige on white. How should fields and quiet controls show where they are?

options.label: Fill with an edge
options.lineage: today's look, finished with a fine line
options.thesis: Fields keep their beige (light) or navy (dark) fill and gain a fine edge; quiet buttons, chips and switches get a fill that stands apart from the panel.
options.viewport: Light and dark: a note box, a title field, a search field, Cancel, two filter chips and a switch, on a panel and on the page.
options.risk: The most change for the least novelty: forms look a little busier than today's soft fills.

options.label: Stronger fill
options.thesis: No lines anywhere: fields, quiet buttons, chips and switches get a fill that clearly differs from the panel and the page, in light and dark.
options.viewport: Light and dark: a note box, a title field, a search field, Cancel, two filter chips and a switch, on a panel and on the page.
options.risk: Closest to today and calm, but still soft in light: a field shows as a shaded box rather than a clear edge.

options.label: Outlined fields
options.thesis: Fields, quiet buttons, chips and switches lose their fill and take a clear grey outline on the panel's own colour.
options.viewport: Light and dark: a note box, a title field, a search field, Cancel, two filter chips and a switch, on a panel and on the page.
options.risk: Clearest edges, but quiet buttons become outlines too, the look you just chose for disabled buttons, so the two can be mistaken.
